name: nosignal-tariff
description: The no-signaling tariff, itemized on one page. The letter's last clause — 'the no-signaling tariff, recorded item by item' — priced the tax only at three operating points inside retro-cache. This repo completes the itemization: three correlator resources pay the same tax through one checker (the cache's marginal across 24 axes under local unitaries and Stinespring CPTP; the order register's input-blind bit; the HJW ensembles' unreadable commitment — each zero verified at the rounding floor), and the cache's withdrawal ships as a full machine-executed schedule: net(p) = (1 - h2((1-p)/2))/2 with exact anchors (0 at the seed floor, 0.094360938, 0.5), a strictly monotone grid, and the binary entropy re-derived by closed form AND Taylor series on two independent paths. The checker enforces the customs laws — an item without a price, an unwitnessed zero ('marketing'), or a dead anchor all fail the build.
